message.content:
It depends on which dessert you’re thinking of—sweet treats come in a rainbow of hues! Here are some common colors you’ll see:

| Dessert | Typical Color(s) | Why it looks that way |
|---------|------------------|-----------------------|
| **Chocolate cake** | Dark brown (sometimes with a glossy chocolate glaze) | Cocoa solids give the deep brown tone. |
| **Vanilla ice cream** | White | The milk‑based base is naturally pale. |
| **Strawberry shortcake** | Pink to deep red | Fresh strawberries and sometimes a hint of pink frosting. |
| **Lemon meringue pie** | Yellow (lemon filling) + white (meringue) | Lemon zest and juice give the bright yellow, while the meringue is airy white. |
| **Red velvet cake** | Deep red | Food coloring (often beet‑derived) gives the signature crimson hue. |
| **Macarons** | Pastel pink, mint green, sky blue, etc. | Food dyes create a spectrum of soft pastel shades. |
| **Pavlova** | White (or off‑white) | Egg whites whipped into a crisp shell. |
| **Tiramisu** | Creamy beige | Layers of mascarpone cream and espresso‑dipped ladyfingers. |
| **Fruit tart** | Multicolored | Fresh fruit slices add bright reds, greens, oranges, etc. |

If you had a specific dessert in mind, let me know and I can give you a more precise answer!
